description: Agent review then authorization of an employee expense reimbursement, capped at the bound max_amount in the bound currency. Evidence is reference-shaped: an expense-report reference and a per-diem policy reference, with additionalProperties closed on both actions so no unmodeled field or document payload rides along. The verifier enforces the shape, not a reference string's contents (no string-format keyword is in its enforceable set), so populating the reference fields with ids/hashes rather than the underlying documents is the integrator's contract. expense_reviewed must precede reimbursement_authorized, and its decision is constrained to "approve": a rejected or needs-info review is not a sealable review under this authorization template, so a nonconformant reject→authorize chain cannot be graded conformant. The authorization is bound to its review (evidence_bindings): reimbursement_authorized must carry the SAME expense_report_ref and amount that were reviewed, so a chain cannot review one report and authorize a different (unreviewed) one. amount is bounded [0, max_amount] on both actions, so a negative reimbursement is nonconformant (and a negative max_amount ceiling yields an empty range, failing closed).
